posts.title: OW2con'26 — two days of open source conversations with PrestaShop
posts.description: The conference took place June 2–3 at Orange Innovation Gardens in Paris–Châtillon, featuring practical discussions, a welcoming community, and high-quality conversations.

posts.title: PrestaShop 9.1.4 and 8.2.7 are available
posts.description: Two maintenance releases published together to ensure a fresh download of either version ships with the patched Faceted Search module (ps_facetedsearch v4.0.4) right away.

posts.title: Security update for the Faceted Search module (ps_facetedsearch)
posts.description: A security vulnerability was identified where specially crafted requests could be processed unsafely by the module and lead to the execution of unauthorized code on the server without requiring authentication.

posts.title: PrestaShop Core Monthly - May 2026
posts.description: Monthly update highlighting a strong maintenance rhythm, two releases on the 9.1 branch, including work on conventions for AI tools and checkout features.

posts.title: PS Summit 2026 - Call for Papers now open (Lyon)
posts.description: November conference in Lyon bringing together the open source ecommerce community and the wider ecosystem with PrestaShop and Sylius communities.

posts.title: PrestaShop 9.1.3 is available
posts.description: Security maintenance release updating latest patch versions of two key upstream dependencies, Symfony and Twig, following their coordinated security advisories.

posts.title: PrestaShop 9.1.2 is available
posts.description: First regular maintenance release for 9.1 branch, focused entirely on bug fixes, stability improvements, and dependency updates.

posts.title: PrestaShop and OSPO Alliance - Turning Community Energy Into Impact
posts.description: Interview discussing what open source means at PrestaShop and how the company maintains a long-running project healthy, collaborative, and sustainable.

posts.title: Teaching AI to speak PrestaShop
posts.description: Exploration of how AI assistants can better understand PrestaShop's modern architecture to avoid producing outdated architectural patterns.

posts.title: PrestaShop Core Monthly - April 2026
posts.description: Monthly summary noting a busy month in the codebase: a critical security release, fast iteration on bringing AI into the project's workflows.

posts.title: PrestaShop 8.2.6 is available
posts.description: Security patch addressing a critical stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability with urgent update recommendation.

posts.title: PrestaShop 9.1.1 is available
posts.description: Security patch for 9.1 branch addressing a critical stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability.

posts.title: PrestaShop Core Monthly - March 2026
posts.description: March milestone including 9.1 release shipped with Hummingbird 2.0 as the default theme and the inaugural Ecommerce Open Source Summit.

posts.title: PrestaShop Live Update - March 2026
posts.description: Live stream featuring new leadership addressing the community questions, and shared their perspective on the project's direction plus One Page Checkout insights.

posts.title: Ecommerce Open Source Summit 2026 - a wrap-up
posts.description: Event recap from March 26 featuring developers, agencies, and ecommerce professionals united by a shared commitment to open source ecommerce.
